title: Maximum Sum of Subsequence With Non-adjacent Elements
summary: Given an array nums consisting of integers and a 2D array queries, where each queries[i] is in the form [posi, xi], for each query i, set nums[posi] to xi.
statement: Given an array nums consisting of integers and a 2D array queries, where each queries[i] is in the form [posi, xi], for each query i, set nums[posi] to xi. Then, calculate the maximum sum of a subsequence of nums where no two adjacent elements are selected. Return the sum of these answers, modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: nums and queries are nonempty; each query [position,value] replaces one array value.
After every update, find the maximum sum of a subsequence containing no adjacent array positions; choosing no value is allowed.
Return the sum of all per-update maxima modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: An interval can be summarized by whether its first and last positions are selected.
Store four endpoint states per segment and merge pairs unless both touching middle endpoints are selected.
Point-update a leaf, rebuild ancestors, add the maximum root state after every query.
Endpoint states contain all information needed across a boundary; induction on the segment tree proves each state is the best valid subsequence with those endpoints.
editorial: Endpoint states contain all information needed across a boundary; induction on the segment tree proves each state is the best valid subsequence with those endpoints.

tests.explanation: The updated maxima are twelve and nine, so their required sum is twenty-one.
The maxima after the updates are five and ten, totaling fifteen.
